benefits.name: Disabled Veteran Real Property Tax Credit
benefits.description: West Virginia provides a personal income tax credit equal to the actual real property tax paid on a residential homestead for honorably discharged veterans from any branch of the U.S. Armed Services who are 90-100% permanently and totally disabled per the VA. The widow(er) of a veteran who claimed the credit in a prior year may also claim it, provided they have not remarried, the homestead has not been sold, and the property has not been reclassified. Real property taxes must be paid timely (first half before October 1, second half before April 1). Taxpayers file a WV Personal Income Tax Return with Form DV-1, entering the total tax paid on IT-140 Line 21(B), and must submit a copy of their property tax receipt(s) and VA disability rating letter. This credit takes precedence over and cannot be combined with the Senior Citizen Tax Credit or Homestead Excess Property Tax Credit.
benefits.value: Income tax credit equal to the actual real property tax paid on the homestead

otherReqs: Homestead used/occupied by owner for at least 6 months, exclusively for residential purposes
Real property taxes must be paid timely (before Oct 1 and before Apr 1)
Cannot be combined with the Senior Citizen Tax Credit or Homestead Excess Property Tax Credit

documentation: Copy of VA Disability Rating letter

benefits.name: Disabled Veteran License Plate
benefits.description: West Virginia veterans with a 100% total and permanent service-connected disability rating from the VA, or who received a grant for a specially adapted vehicle, may obtain a Disabled Veteran license plate. The application (DMV-48-D) must first be certified by the West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance, then submitted to a DMV Regional Office. Holders are not required to pay registration fees for one Disabled Veteran plate, but must pay the 50-cent insurance enforcement fee and a $1.00-per-year litter fee for each remaining year in the plate's 10-year cycle; a personalized version carries an additional $15.00 per remaining year.
benefits.value: Registration fee waived for one plate; insurance enforcement fee (50 cents) and $1.00/year litter fee still apply

otherReqs: Application must be certified by the WV Department of Veterans Assistance before DMV submission
Applies to one Disabled Veteran plate per veteran

application.agency: West Virginia Division of Motor Vehicles
documentation: VA certification of 100% total and permanent service-connected disability, or specially adapted vehicle grant
Certification from the WV Department of Veterans Assistance

benefits.name: Disabled Veteran Hunting, Trapping, and Fishing License Exemption
benefits.description: West Virginia resident veterans who are certified by the Commissioner of the Division of Motor Vehicles as exempt from motor vehicle registration fees on account of a service-connected disability (the same 100% total-and-permanent standard used for the Disabled Veteran license plate) are permitted to hunt, trap, or fish in the state without obtaining a license. The Director of the Division of Natural Resources establishes rules for certification, application, and identification requirements while hunting, trapping, or fishing.
benefits.value: Hunting, trapping, and fishing without a license

otherReqs: Must hold DMV certification as exempt from motor vehicle registration fees on account of service-connected disability
Must carry required identification while hunting, trapping, or fishing per DNR rules

application.agency: West Virginia Division of Natural Resources
documentation: DMV certification of exemption from motor vehicle registration fees due to service-connected disability

benefits.name: State Employment Veterans' Preference Points
benefits.description: West Virginia adds 5 points to the final passing civil service examination score of eligible veterans who served full-time active duty (per 10 U.S.C. §101(d) or 32 U.S.C. §502, §503, or §904) and were discharged or released under honorable conditions, or who completed more than 90 consecutive days of full-time active-duty training with the National Guard or Military Reserves. Disabled veterans (those with an established service-connected disability or receiving VA compensation, disability retirement benefits, or a pension) receive an additional 5 points (maximum 10 total), and Purple Heart recipients likewise receive an additional 5 points (maximum 10 total). Applicants must submit a copy of their DD Form 214; disabled veterans must also submit a VA letter dated within the last 6 months.
benefits.value: 5 points added to civil service exam score for veterans; up to 10 total for disabled veterans or Purple Heart recipients

otherReqs: Honorable discharge or release, or 90+ consecutive days of full-time active-duty training with National Guard/Reserves
Disabled veteran / Purple Heart tiers require additional documentation (VA letter dated within 6 months, or DD-214 showing the award)

documentation: VA letter dated within the last 6 months (for disabled veteran preference points)

benefits.name: West Virginia Veterans Nursing Facilities (Clarksburg and Barboursville)
benefits.description: West Virginia operates veterans-exclusive nursing facilities in Clarksburg (a 120-bed facility with direct breezeway access to the Louis A. Johnson VA Medical Center, round-the-clock nursing staff, on-site pharmacy, a specialized 20-bed Alzheimer's/dementia unit, and therapy rooms) and Barboursville. Eligibility generally requires an honorable discharge or general discharge under honorable conditions; specific facilities have additional requirements such as minimum active-duty service length and, for Barboursville, that the veteran be ambulatory and independent in activities of daily living. Care costs are described as significantly less than the national average for nursing facility care.
benefits.value: Veterans-exclusive skilled nursing care, significantly below the national average cost

otherReqs: Honorable discharge or general discharge under honorable conditions
Facility-specific service-length and (for Barboursville) ambulatory/independence requirements

application.agency: West Virginia Department of Veterans Assistance

benefits.name: State Parks Lodging Discount for Veterans
benefits.description: West Virginia veterans and active-duty military receive a 10 percent discount on all standard lodge rooms, cabins, and campsites operated by West Virginia State Parks, available year-round.
benefits.value: 10% discount on standard lodge rooms, cabins, and campsites, year-round

otherReqs: Available to veterans and active-duty military

application.agency: West Virginia State Parks / Department of Veterans Assistance
documentation: Proof of veteran or active-duty status
